# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_priority_flow_control (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the PFC profile.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `pause_threshold` (String) Transmit a pause frame (XOFF) when the amount of enqueued packets reaches this threshold. Accepts a percentage, an amount of bytes, or `auto`.
- `resume_threshold` (String) Transmit a resume frame (XON) when the amount of enqueued packets drops to this threshold. Accepts a percentage, an amount of bytes, or `auto`.
- `rx` (Boolean) Enables receiving of PFC frames.
- `traffic_class` (String) The list of PFC-enabled traffic classes. Accepts a comma separated list of traffic classes (0..7).
- `tx` (Boolean) Enables transmission of PFC frames.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `hw_id` (Number) The index the PFC profile occupies in the switch chip.
- `hw_offloaded` (Boolean) Whether the PFC profile is programmed into the switch chip.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
